# GSAP 3.14.2 (bundled)

`gsap.min.js` is the unmodified `dist/gsap.min.js` of the npm package `gsap@3.14.2`, fetched once from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js. `vedit build` copies it to
`.vedit/hf/assets/gsap.min.js` and every `index.html` loads it from there: renders never depend on a CDN.

- sha256: `c174bfce53a729418d57a8ad8625e7247c793a22fef8e2851e3cfa3de9cd8280` (matches jsdelivr's listed hash)
- licence: GreenSock Standard "no charge" licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license (header kept in the file)
- version pin: `vedit/versions.py` `GSAP`; to upgrade, replace the file and the pin together.
